svg.text: Strengths and Difficulties Questionnaire (SDQ) outcome measurement for focused psychosocial support programmes in Lebanon
2 · Measurement process (one cycle per child, programme year as reporting period)
3 · Business capabilities (what the platform must provide)
• Consent first: no permission → application closed, nothing else recorded
• Codes are generated by the server; devices never invent them
• One partner quota per year; collectors see only their own applications
• More than 3 'no answer' items → application marked Not Applicable
• Submitted questionnaires are locked; decreases need a justification
• Scores are computed centrally with one agreed scoring policy
• Data anonymised by code; no child names stored
7 · Outcomes and indicators the business reads from the system
• Share of children whose total difficulties score improved (Increase) after the programme
• Distribution normal / borderline / abnormal per scale and age band, pre vs post
• Coverage: applications per partner, governorate and year against quota
• Dropout rate and reasons; uncompleted post-tests per partner
• Data quality: not-applicable rate, pending submissions, unjustified decreases
